bundle.shortDescription: Build Linux devicetrees on a node canvas
bundle.longDescription: A graphical editor for Linux devicetrees: nodes on a canvas, wired together, with the element library built from the binding schemas of a local Linux kernel checkout. Imports existing board files and exports .dts and .dtb.
